title: Forty Springs
style_block: warm hand-painted look, soft paper grain, dappled green and turquoise light, clear spring water, tall trees, red-brown earth bank, gentle watercolour edges, anatomically correct people with exactly two arms and two hands each

characters.name: Bereket (Beki)
characters.look: the oldest and tallest of the three brothers, a lanky 19-year-old Ethiopian, with warm brown skin, short curly black hair, athletic build, plain swim shorts

characters.name: Tesahun (Tesfa)
characters.look: the middle brother, a slim 17-year-old Ethiopian, with warm brown skin, short black hair, plain swim shorts

characters.name: Abenezer (Abeni)
characters.look: the youngest, a 16-year-old Ethiopian, with warm brown skin, short black hair, slightly shorter than the others, plain swim shorts

shots.reason: Say where we are: the spring itself, before anyone appears.
shots.image_prompt: Wide view of the spring from the bank in early morning light, the turquoise pool and the fallen log under the water, no people

motion.prompt: slow gentle push in, ripples moving on the water, leaves stirring in the breeze

shots.reason: Meet the three brothers without needing faces, and say how old they were.
shots.narration: We only ever needed one. I was sixteen, Tesfa was seventeen, Beki was nineteen.
shots.image_prompt: Three brothers walking side by side along the red earth path toward the spring, seen from behind at a middle distance, towels over their shoulders, the tallest on the left and the smallest on the right, arms at their sides

motion.prompt: slow push in on the three walking

shots.reason: The oldest goes first: Beki's jump starts the day.
shots.narration: Beki, the oldest, always jumped first, even when the water was cold.
shots.image_prompt: Seen from far away across the pool: the tallest brother as a small dark silhouette high in the air above the spring against bright morning light through the trees, a simple clear body shape, arms out

shots.reason: The middle brother follows: Tesfa goes second, shown by his splash.
shots.image_prompt: A big white splash crown rising from the middle of the turquoise pool where the middle brother has just landed, only the top of his head visible inside the splash, droplets in the sunlight, seen from the bank

motion.prompt: the splash rises and falls back into the pool, ripples spread, camera steady

shots.reason: The youngest goes last: Abeni hesitates at the edge, then leaps.
shots.image_prompt: The youngest brother standing at the top of the red earth bank, seen from behind and far away, small in the frame, arms straight down at his sides, looking down at the turquoise pool

motion.prompt: slow push in on the boy at the edge

shots.reason: The tricks off the fallen tree: Tesfa's favourite stunt (listener test 1).
shots.narration: Then it was flips off the fallen tree, and whatever tricks we could think of.
shots.image_prompt: Far away: a tiny dark silhouette of a boy mid-flip in the air above a fallen tree trunk that leans out over the spring, against bright sunlight through the leaves, water drops glittering below

shots.reason: A close detail of the splashing, to show the joy without a body.
shots.image_prompt: Close detail of the turquoise water surface of the spring exploding into bright spray and flying water drops in the sunlight, ripples spreading, no people, no hands

motion.prompt: water drops fly up and fall back, ripples spread outward, camera slowly pulls out

shots.reason: The core feeling: all three together, shouting and laughing.
shots.narration: And all of us shouting. Whoa! Whoa! Whoa!
shots.image_prompt: The three brothers in the middle of the turquoise pool at a middle distance, only their heads and shoulders above the water, arms hidden under the surface, mouths open shouting and laughing, the tallest on the left

motion.prompt: slow gentle push in on the three

shots.reason: Time has passed: the empty spring, quiet, to land the longing.
shots.narration: I would give a lot to hear that noise again.
shots.image_prompt: The same spring at golden evening light, empty and still, the fallen log visible under the water, long soft shadows, no people

motion.prompt: ripples settle on the water, light flickers through the leaves, camera slowly pulls out

shots.reason: Closing image: the three sitting together, no words needed.
shots.image_prompt: The three brothers sitting side by side on the red earth bank, seen from behind, their feet in the water, warm evening light, the tallest on the left

motion.prompt: very slow push in on the three

music.caption: warm gentle acoustic instrumental, soft plucked strings, light hand percussion, airy and playful, nostalgic, no vocals

end_card.text: Made with AI. Painted from memory.

references.prompt: Wide establishing view of one forest spring in Arba Minch, Ethiopia: a round clear turquoise pool, a large fallen log lying under the water, a steep red-brown earth bank on the left, a fallen tree trunk leaning out over the water on the right, tall trees all around, morning sun through the leaves, no people
references.use: the spring: the same turquoise pool, the fallen log under the water, the red-brown bank and the fallen trunk leaning over the water

references.prompt: Character reference sheet of three Ethiopian teenage brothers standing side by side facing the viewer, full body, arms relaxed straight down at their sides, plain pale background, each with exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. Left: the oldest, 19, the tallest, lanky, short curly black hair. Middle: 17, slim, short black hair. Right: the youngest, 16, a little shorter, short black hair. All three have the same warm brown skin and a clear family resemblance, and wear plain dark swim shorts
references.use: the three brothers: keep their faces, builds, heights, skin and swim shorts
